title: Wear and Share in Pictures: Clothes Collection Drives · AquaTerra
description: Photos from {count} Wear and Share clothes collection drives around Kolkata, {firstYear} to {lastYear}. Apartments, neighbourhoods and what they gathered.
lede: Wear and Share is AquaTerra's clothes collection series. It has run {count} drives from {firstYear} to {lastYear} across {placesCount} places, with {volunteers} volunteer turnouts, and each one gathered donated clothes for people who need them.

2024.heading: apartments and an autumn run
2024.text: In 2024 we ran {year:2024} drives. The photos run from July to November, and many were held in apartment complexes such as Raghav Residency, Vistar Apartment, Ganges Sky and Himdari Apartment. One October drive at Urbana sorted donated items by type and condition, so they could be handed out more easily.

2025.heading: toys, and a july rush
2025.text: In 2025 we ran {year:2025} drives. The first photos are from late March, when a Toy and Thread drive at New Alipore gathered toys and clothes for people who need comfort. In April the photos move to Salt Lake, and then to a burst of drives between 9 and 13 July across Laketown, Club Town Greens, Howrah, Avani Oxford and Bangur.

closing: Each drive has its own page with the place, the date and what it gathered. Read [the full story](/impact/wear-and-share) for every drive in words, or see the related [Wear and Write](/impact/wear-and-write) page.

faqs.a: AquaTerra gathers old clothes through Wear and Share collection drives, with {count} drives since {firstYear} across {placesCount} places. Many were held at apartment complexes, so check with the [contact page](/contact) before you bring anything.

faqs.q: Where did AquaTerra collect clothes in 2025?
faqs.a: Wear and Share ran {year:2025} drives in 2025. A Toy and Thread drive gathered toys and clothes at New Alipore in March, and the July drives ran at Natural City Laketown, Salt Lake, Club Town Greens, Howrah AC, Avani Oxford and Bangur.

In 2024 Wear and Share held {year:2024} drives, with photos from July to November. They gathered donated clothes at apartment complexes such as Raghav Residency and Ganges Sky, and at Sealdah, Ballygunge, Alipore Road and The Reserve, with a sorting drive at Urbana in October.
